title: An incomplete run capped by max_output_tokens finishes as length
rationale: Responses reports completion as a run status plus an incomplete_details.reason; Chat Completions reports it as one per-choice string. They are translated rather than passed through, so an operator flipping api: does not find FinishReason saying max_output_tokens where it used to say length -- every consumer of llm.response and llm.batch.results reads one vocabulary.
